raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Add `AiterTritonMxfp8LinearKernel`, an MXFP8 (OCP MX, 1x32 E8M0 scales) dense linear
backend for gfx950 that calls AITER's Triton `gemm_afp8wfp8`. It is first in the
ROCm MXFP8 kernel list and claims only the `(N, K)` shapes AITER ships tuned
configs for; every other shape falls through to `RocmDotScaledMxfp8LinearKernel`
unchanged. Requires `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`. With `--linear-backend aiter` it
takes every MXFP8 shape, untuned ones on AITER's default tile (slower than
`RocmDotScaledMxfp8LinearKernel`).

Depends on ROCm/aiter#7038 (tuned `GEMM-AFP8WFP8_A32_W1X32` configs). With
an AITER that lacks those configs, `can_implement()` returns False for every
shape and behaviour is identical to today.

## Changes

- `kernels/linear/mxfp8/aiter.py`: new kernel, gated on
  `rocm_aiter_ops.is_linear_enabled()`.
- `_aiter_ops.py`: `rocm_aiter_triton_mxfp8_gemm_dynamic_quant` custom op (dynamic
  activation quant via `mxfp8_e4m3_quantize`, then `gemm_afp8wfp8`) with a fake
  impl for torch.compile, the `rocm_aiter_ops.triton_mxfp8_gemm_dynamic_quant` wrapper,
  and `rocm_aiter_ops.is_triton_gemm_afp8wfp8_tuned(n, k)` (cached; returns False
  when AITER or the config family is missing).
- `kernels/linear/__init__.py`: register first for ROCm, and under
  `--linear-backend aiter` (which also takes untuned shapes).
- Disabled under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT` (the tuned decode configs use split-K).

## Test Plan

- `pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_mxfp8_kernel_selection.py` (CPU): ROCm
  selection prefers AITER only for tuned shapes, and takes every shape under
  `--linear-backend aiter`; rejects unaligned K / BMM; off under batch invariance.
- `pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_rocm_mxfp8_linear.py` (gfx950): the
  dequant-reference test is now parametrized over `rocm_native` and `aiter`
  (DeepSeek V4.1 TP4 attention and MiniMax-M3.1 TP4 shapes, all tuned in AITER;
  M = 1 to 1024), plus
  a 3D input + bias test for AITER, and forced untuned shapes on AITER's default
  tile (M = 1 to 8193).
- Kernel microbenchmark vs `rocm_native` (CUDA-graph timing, activation quant
  included on both sides).
- End to end: MiniMax-M3-MXFP8, TP8 and TP4, MI350X, `vllm bench serve` random dataset;
  baseline = `VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=AiterTritonMxfp8LinearKernel`. Same A/B on
  DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4.
- Accuracy: gsm8k 5-shot via `lm_eval` local-completions, and GPQA-Diamond
  0-shot CoT via local-chat-completions, real weights, same A/B.

## Test Result

- Selection tests: 46 passed.
- GPU tests: `test_rocm_mxfp8_linear.py` 264 passed (MI350X).
- Kernel speedup vs `rocm_native` (MiniMax-M3 TP8 shapes):

| M | qkv | o_proj | shared gate_up | shared down |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1.37 | 1.14 | 1.39 | 1.11 |
| 8 | 1.33 | 1.10 | 1.39 | 1.08 |
| 64 | 1.34 | 1.53 | 1.18 | 1.14 |
| 128 | 1.70 | 1.13 | 1.00 | 1.14 |
| 512 | 1.55 | 0.97 | 1.76 | 0.94 |
| 1024 | 1.03 | 1.13 | 1.39 | 1.06 |
| 2048 | 0.99 | 1.02 | 1.00 | 1.01 |
| 8192 | 1.16 | 1.23 | 1.04 | 1.05 |
| 16384 | 1.23 | 1.24 | 1.15 | 1.09 |
| 32768 | 1.52 | 1.57 | 1.26 | 1.35 |

- Accuracy, gsm8k 5-shot exact match (flexible / strict): baseline
  0.9075 / 0.9067, AITER 0.9098 / 0.9083 (stderr 0.008).
- Accuracy, GPQA-Diamond (0-shot CoT, flexible-extract, n=198):

| Model | baseline (rocm_native) | AITER |
|---|---|---|
| MiniMax-M3-MXFP8 TP8 | 0.8485 ± 0.026 | 0.8333 ± 0.027 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 | 0.8030 ± 0.028 | 0.8030 ± 0.028 |

- Kernel selection log: baseline `Using RocmDotScaledMxfp8LinearKernel`;
  AITER `Using AiterTritonMxfp8LinearKernel` and `Using RocmDotScaledMxfp8LinearKernel`
  (untuned shapes fall back).
- End to end, MiniMax-M3-MXFP8, TP8, MI350X, real weights, medians:

| in / out | conc | TTFT ms (base → AITER) | TPOT ms | output tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1024 / 512 | 1 | 97.1 → 106.3 | 7.93 → 7.71 | 123.4 → 126.5 |
| 1024 / 512 | 16 | 368.2 → 370.8 | 10.59 → 10.37 | 1417 → 1445 |
| 1024 / 512 | 64 | 647.8 → 783.1 | 19.10 → 18.59 | 3147 → 3185 |
| 8192 / 256 | 1 | 212.1 → 207.1 | 8.00 → 7.78 | 113.7 → 116.9 |
| 8192 / 256 | 16 | 1401.5 → 1286.7 | 16.26 → 16.24 | 737.8 → 754.0 |
| 8192 / 256 | 64 | 1988.1 → 1896.9 | 54.37 → 52.88 | 1031.9 → 1063.5 |

  The 1024-token rows at conc 1 and 64 are from a second run with the
  variant order reversed and 16x prompts; the regression reproduced.

- End to end, MiniMax-M3-MXFP8, TP4 (same setup), medians:

| in / out | conc | TTFT ms (base → AITER) | TPOT ms | output tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1024 / 512 | 1 | 93.2 → 106.3 | 8.10 → 7.84 | 120.9 → 124.5 |
| 1024 / 512 | 16 | 447.5 → 442.8 | 13.24 → 13.08 | 1136 → 1150 |
| 1024 / 512 | 64 | 867.7 → 839.4 | 26.12 → 25.07 | 2304 → 2400 |
| 8192 / 256 | 1 | 264.4 → 258.6 | 8.15 → 7.90 | 109.3 → 112.7 |
| 8192 / 256 | 16 | 1575.5 → 1499.6 | 21.28 → 20.82 | 584.4 → 601.0 |
| 8192 / 256 | 64 | 2628.9 → 2527.6 | 70.72 → 67.41 | 791.1 → 829.5 |

- End to end, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (32x32 E8M0 weight blocks; baseline is
  `rocm_mxfp8_block32_gemm`), TP4, MI350X, medians:

| in / out | conc | TTFT ms (base → AITER) | TPOT ms | output tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1024 / 512 | 1 | 95.0 → 97.9 | 7.74 → 7.69 | 126.5 → 127.2 |
| 1024 / 512 | 16 | 450.6 → 454.8 | 10.31 → 10.19 | 1432 → 1447 |
| 1024 / 512 | 64 | 905.7 → 902.6 | 16.79 → 16.71 | 3452 → 3469 |
| 8192 / 256 | 1 | 219.7 → 218.0 | 7.88 → 7.78 | 114.8 → 116.3 |
| 8192 / 256 | 16 | 1154.1 → 1133.7 | 18.05 → 17.94 | 710.8 → 716.9 |
| 8192 / 256 | 64 | 2015.4 → 1994.5 | 55.83 → 55.28 | 1006.7 → 1016.7 |

Known trade-off: TTFT for short prompts at high concurrency is higher on
MiniMax-M3 (TP8: up to +21% at 1024 tokens, conc 64; TP4: +14% at 1024
tokens, conc 1). Cause: prefill
batches above the CUDA-graph capture sizes run eagerly, and at M around 1024
these GEMMs are host-launch bound. Host time per call is about 72 us for
AITER (vLLM quant 18.5 + `gemm_afp8wfp8` 42) versus 41 us for `rocm_native`.

---

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project

+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+    MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE,
+    MXFP8_SCALE_DTYPE,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.utils import replace_parameter
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from .Mxfp8LinearKernel import Mxfp8LinearKernel, Mxfp8LinearLayerConfig
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _aiter_backend_forced() -> bool:
+    """Whether ``--linear-backend`` explicitly requests AITER for MXFP8."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear import _get_linear_backend
+
+    return _get_linear_backend(quantization="mxfp8") == "aiter"
+
+
+class AiterTritonMxfp8LinearKernel(Mxfp8LinearKernel):
+    """AITER Triton MXFP8 GEMM on ROCm."""
+
+    supports_pre_processed_weights = True
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported(
+        cls, compute_capability: int | None = None
+    ) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+            return False, "AITER is only supported on ROCm"
+
+        if not current_platform.supports_mx():
+            return False, "requires platform with MX support"
+
+        if envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT:
+            return False, "tuned buckets use split K; not batch invariant"
+
+        if rocm_aiter_ops.is_linear_enabled():
+            return True, None
+        return False, "AITER not found or not supported on the current platform"
+
+    @classmethod
+    def can_implement(cls, config: Mxfp8LinearLayerConfig) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        N, K = config.weight_shape
+        if config.bmm_batch_size is not None:
+            return False, "batched MXFP8 GEMM is not supported"
+        if K % MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE != 0:
+            return False, f"K={K} is not a multiple of {MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE}"
+        if rocm_aiter_ops.is_triton_gemm_afp8wfp8_tuned(N, K):
+            return True, None
+        # Untuned shapes are slower than native, so take them only when forced.
+        if not _aiter_backend_forced():
+            return False, f"AITER has no tuned MXFP8 config for N={N}, K={K}"
+        logger.info_once(
+            "--linear-backend=aiter: MXFP8 shapes without a tuned AITER config "
+            "use AITER's default tile, which is slower than the native kernel."
+        )
+        return True, None
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        weight = layer.weight.data
+        N, K = weight.shape
+        scale_k = K // MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE
+        weight_scale = layer.weight_scale.data[:N, :scale_k]
+
+        replace_parameter(layer, "weight", weight.contiguous())
+        replace_parameter(layer, "weight_scale", weight_scale.contiguous())
+
+    def apply_weights(
+        self,
+        layer: torch.nn.Module,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if layer.weight_scale.dtype != MXFP8_SCALE_DTYPE:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Expected {MXFP8_SCALE_DTYPE} weight_scale, got "
+                f"{layer.weight_scale.dtype}."
+            )
+        out_shape = (*x.shape[:-1], layer.weight.shape[0])
+        x2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1])
+        out = rocm_aiter_ops.triton_mxfp8_gemm_dynamic_quant(
+            x2d, layer.weight, layer.weight_scale, x.dtype
+        )
+        out = out.reshape(out_shape)
+        if bias is not None:
+            out = out + bias
+        return out
